# RecruitAI

> RecruitAI is an autonomous multi-agent recruitment platform and precision candidate intelligence system. It automates technical candidate evaluations, provides instant deep resume ingestion, enforces blind screening to eliminate bias, and coordinates human-in-the-loop hiring actions.

RecruitAI is designed for modern hiring teams, technical recruiters, and talent leaders who demand high accuracy, auditability, and speed without sacrificing human judgment or candidate data privacy.

## Core Capabilities

- **Autonomous Multi-Agent Orchestration**: Specialized LangGraph agents handle resume parsing, JD analysis, candidate evaluation, interview question generation, and personalized outreach drafting.
- **Objective Rubric Scoring**: Automatically translates job descriptions into multi-dimensional rubrics (technical skills, relevant experience, impact metrics) and grades candidates against uniform standards.
- **Blind Candidate Screening**: Eliminates demographic bias by redacting names, contact information, gender markers, dates, and locations prior to evaluation.
- **Human-in-the-Loop Safeguards**: Outreach emails, calendar scheduling, and candidate status decisions require explicit human confirmation before dispatch.
- **ATS Export & Full Interoperability**: Seamless 1-click JSON and CSV export formats tailored for Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, and Ashby.
- **Enterprise-Grade Data Isolation**: Multi-tenant Row-Level Security (RLS) via Supabase ensures users can only access their own jobs, resumes, and evaluation runs.

## Technical Architecture

- **Web Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP & Framer Motion animations.
- **Mobile Client**: Expo 57 / React Native, NativeWind, SecureStore offline-first architecture.
- **Backend API**: FastAPI (Python 3.12+), Pydantic v2 schemas, streaming server-sent events.
- **AI & RAG Engine**: Google Gemini 2.0 / 1.5 Pro & Flash with fallback failover, Google Cloud Text Embeddings (text-embedding-004), LangGraph state graphs.
- **Database & Auth**: PostgreSQL with pgvector, Supabase Authentication & Row-Level Security.
